result_text:
I fixed the `all_files.zip` export so it no longer depends on the fixed `aspect_*.txt` names. It compiles (`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`), but I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config, so the fix is untested.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It now collects the five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) in that order. For each one it gets the entry name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is the same call that writes the loose text files. It reads the file under that name and uses the same name for the zip entry.

- **Default config:** the entry names and order are unchanged.
- **Renamed aspect:** with `buildAndDeploymentAspect` renamed as in your example, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written again, because it no longer sits behind the failing read.

I did not touch `LandscapeAnalyzer.java` in the `codeanalyzer` module. It also reads `aspect_main.txt` and `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` by fixed name, so it likely has the same problem with renamed aspects.
